words: The Lark ticket you submit for bank, withdraw and deposit cases. Each scenario names the query to pick, for example Missing WD or WD Delay.
The tick in the relevant tracker after you submit any ticket.
Checking the member's identity again in this chat. A check from a previous chat never counts.
When the code does not arrive, you read it from the BO (TC: SMS Sent Record; 96 BO: User TAC), check it has not expired, and give it to the member.
The identity verification the member must pass, for example before a PIN reset or a Zyra bank change.
For a TNG bank change, the proof is the TNG profile showing the name and DuitNow ID.
The total valid bet amount. A withdrawal is blocked until the required TO is met in the correct game.

tour.label: When
tour.title: Before you work any Livechat case
items: Find the scenario by category: Registration, Account, Bank, Withdraw, Deposit, Fund, Others
Run a fresh identity verification this chat before any reset
Tag the chat correctly (Tags & Categories)
tour.done: Work the four stages of the scenario, left to right.
tour.notYet: Do all three. A verification from a previous chat never counts.

tour.label: Do
tour.title: Four stages, then tick Claimed
items: Get details
Ask for what the scenario lists, usually Username/UID plus the amount, receipt or screenshot.
Verify / check
Check the BO or the tool the scenario names before acting.
Action / submit
Act, submit the CS-PYM ticket, or escalate to WL, Support or IT, as the row says.
Notify / close
Tell the member the result. Close with an offer of further assistance and a good-luck wish.
Tick Claimed
After any ticket, tick the Claimed checkbox in the relevant tracker.

tour.label: Common cases
tour.title: Six rows you will use often
tour.secLabel: 5. Account, and the other scenario tables
items: Delete game account
Not permitted. Find the true intent, persuade and console, offer high-pay games.
Remove bank details
Not a duplicate and no valid reason: advise we cannot remove bank details.
OTP keeps failing
Advise retry after 12am. Report to the Senior.
Delayed WD
Over 10 min: submit CS-PYM, query WD Delay, and keep following.
Deposit below RM 10
Member tops up the difference. Submit CS-PYM, comment combine deposit.
3rd-party deposit
Cannot process. Get the sender details; refund to the sender's account only.

tour.label: Never
tour.title: Five hard stops
items: Delete a game account or remove bank details without a valid, verified reason.
Process a 3rd-party deposit. Refund only to the sender's account.
Escalate without Username/UID, amount and screenshots. It bounces back.
Reset a password or PIN on a previous chat's verification.
Close a chat without the further-assistance offer and a good-luck wish.

tour.label: Escalate
tour.title: Who takes it from you
items: PYM
Bank, withdraw and deposit cases: Lark ticket CS-PYM with the query the row names.
WL / Support / IT
Technical registration faults, game access problems, missing funds with no maintenance notice.
Senior
OTP that keeps failing.
Designated admin
Member insists on unsubscribing from SMS promo or Push: post in the VIP group and tag the designated admin.
Chinese-speaking CS
Complex case with a Chinese-speaking member. Otherwise use ChatGPT.

pool.q: A member asks you to delete his game account. What do you do?
o: Deletion is not permitted: find his true intent, console him, offer high-pay games
pool.why: Account: deletion is not permitted. Find the true intent, persuade and console.

pool.q: A member's withdrawal is still not through after 15 minutes. Next step?
o: Tell him to wait another day
Submit CS-PYM, query WD Delay, and keep following
pool.why: Delayed WD: over 10 min, submit CS-PYM with query WD Delay and follow up.

pool.q: A member transferred RM 6. The minimum is RM 10. How do you handle it?
o: Advise a top-up to reach RM 10, then submit CS-PYM, comment combine deposit
pool.why: Deposit below minimum: member deposits the difference, then CS-PYM with comment combine deposit.

pool.q: The BO shows a deposit came from someone else's bank account. What now?
o: Cannot process: get the sender details and refund to the sender only
Refund to the member's own account
pool.why: Never process a 3rd-party deposit. Refund only to the sender's account.

pool.q: What must every escalation to WL, Support, IT or PYM carry?
o: A summary in your own words
pool.why: Golden Rules: Username/UID, amount and screenshots, or the escalation bounces back.

pool.q: You just submitted a CS-PYM ticket. What is the next thing you do?
o: Tick the Claimed checkbox in the relevant tracker
pool.why: After submitting any ticket, tick the Claimed checkbox in the relevant tracker.

pool.q: You verified a member yesterday. Today he asks for a PIN reset. What do you do?
o: Reset it, he is already verified
Verify him again in this chat first
Ask the Senior to reset it
pool.why: Run a fresh identity verification every chat; never rely on a previous one.

pool.q: On TC, the member still cannot get in after Get Code and a manual OTP. What do you advise?
o: Retry after 12am, and report it to the Senior
pool.why: OTP Failed: if it keeps failing, advise retry after 12am and report to the Senior.

pool.q: A member cannot withdraw. BO Turnover Checking shows the required TO is not met. What do you tell him?
o: Complete the required TO in the correct game
pool.why: Unable to Withdraw, turnover not met: advise completing the required TO in the correct game.

o: An offer of further assistance plus a good-luck wish
pool.why: Golden Rules: always close with an offer of further assistance plus a good-luck wish.

pool.q: After you explain the benefits, a member still insists on stopping SMS promos. What do you do?
o: Remove him yourself in the BO
Post in the VIP group and tag the designated admin to remove
Tell him it is not possible
pool.why: Unsubscribe SMS Promo: if the member insists, post in the VIP group and tag the designated admin.

pool.q: A member's funds went missing in a game. The TG maintenance group shows no notice. Next?
pool.why: Fund Missing: if there is no notice, escalate to WL / Support.
